description: Synthetic technical-resume passages. Relevance labels were authored before model inference. Labels represent retrieval relevance, not proof of proficiency.

passages.text: For three years I developed Python services with Django and Django REST Framework, including versioned HTTP endpoints used by partner systems.
Designed the PostgreSQL schema and optimized queries for a warehouse inventory backend project.
Wrote Dockerfiles and Docker Compose services, then operated the containerized application in production.
Skills: Python, Django, PostgreSQL, Docker, JavaScript.
Built production Python microservices with FastAPI and maintained an older Flask service; I have not used Django professionally.
Administered MySQL databases and tuned indexes for high-volume order processing.
Deployed services to virtual machines using systemd. No Docker experience.
Created a FastAPI inventory project exposing JSON resources over stateless HTTP endpoints for mobile clients.
Completed a professional certificate in cloud operations.
Implemented Node.js services in JS and JavaScript, publishing resource-oriented HTTP endpoints consumed by web applications.
Operated PostgreSQL for a reporting platform, including backup validation and query analysis.
Tools and skills: Git, Docker, Linux, TypeScript.
Produced a visual design portfolio containing brand illustrations and print layouts.
Coursework toward a BSc in Computer Science; completion status was not stated.
Bachelor of Science in Computer Science, awarded by Northbridge University in 2022.
Provided desktop support, managed ticket queues, and prepared end-user training materials.
Built a Python forecasting notebook for a university statistics course; it was not a web backend.

queries.rationale: Django must be supported by experience; related Python frameworks, negation, and a skills-list mention are not sufficient.

queries.text: experience building backend services with Python
queries.rationale: Both Django and FastAPI work are valid Python backend evidence; a non-web notebook is related but not relevant.
MySQL is related database work but not PostgreSQL evidence.

queries.text: used Docker to containerize and deploy production services
queries.rationale: Explicit deployment is relevant; negation and skills-list-only mention are not experience evidence.
For broad discovery, skills-list mentions are relevant, while explicit negation is not.

queries.text: developed REST APIs for other applications to consume
queries.rationale: Versioned HTTP endpoints, stateless JSON resources, and resource-oriented endpoints are REST paraphrases.

queries.text: professional JavaScript or JS backend experience
queries.rationale: JS and JavaScript are aliases, but a skills list alone is not professional experience.

queries.text: completed a relevant backend software project
queries.rationale: Inventory backend work is relevant; visual design and a non-web notebook are not.

queries.text: completed bachelor's degree in computer science
queries.rationale: An awarded degree is relevant; incomplete or ambiguous coursework and an unrelated certificate are not.
